description: End-to-end order-to-cash workflow for 5G UDM (Unified Data Management) subscription and profile lifecycle, including ordering, provisioning, policy/profile management, charging linkage, and rollback.

subscriber_id.description: Global unique identifier for a subscriber (e.g., IMSI, SUPI, or internal UUID).

order_id.description: Identifier of an order capturing requested UDM-related changes.

subscription_id.description: Identifier for a specific UDM subscription (data set) instance.

provisioning_task_id.description: Identifier for an asynchronous provisioning task in UDM or related network functions.

charge_session_id.description: Identifier linking UDM subscription events to charging/mediation flows.

udm_profile.description: Abstract UDM profile containing identity, subscription, and policy-related data.

key_profile_id.description: Reference to key material or key profile.

slices.description: Allowed network slices for this service.

default_indicator.description: Whether this slice is default for the service.

chargeable_event.description: Event data for charging and mediation related to UDM actions.

monetary_amount.description: Amount to be charged or credited.

attributes.description: Additional event attributes used by charging system.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: search_udm_offers
functions.description: Search for available 5G UDM-related offers and bundles for a subscriber, including slice and QoS capabilities.

subscriber_context.description: Information about the subscriber used to filter offers.

functions.returns: List of matching UDM-related commercial offers with high-level capabilities and pricing.

functions.name: create_udm_order
functions.description: Create an order for UDM subscription creation or modification based on selected offer and subscriber profile.

external_order_ref.description: Optional external order reference from CRM/BSS.

requested_udm_profile.description: Desired UDM profile state for create or update actions.

requested_effective_time.description: When the order should become effective; immediate if omitted.

functions.returns: Newly created UDM order with order_id, initial status, and any validation warnings.

functions.name: validate_udm_order
functions.description: Run technical and policy validations on a pending UDM order before provisioning.

run_what_if_provisioning.description: If true, simulate provisioning to detect potential runtime issues.

validation_scopes.description: List of validation categories to run.

functions.returns: Validation result including pass/fail flags, detailed errors, and suggestions for correction.

functions.name: submit_udm_order
functions.description: Submit a validated UDM order into the fulfillment/provisioning pipeline.

notify_webhooks.description: Optional list of webhook endpoints to notify about order state changes.

functions.returns: Order submission acknowledgment including current status, created provisioning_task_ids, and optional charge_session_id.

functions.name: get_udm_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and progress of a UDM order and related provisioning tasks.
functions.returns: Order object with overall state, per-task provisioning statuses, and optional charge/mediation linkage.

functions.name: provision_udm_subscription
functions.description: Trigger or re-trigger UDM-level provisioning for a given order or standalone subscription change.

order_id.description: Primary reference; either order_id or subscription_id must be provided.

subscription_id.description: Direct subscription reference for ad-hoc provisioning without an order.

target_network_functions.description: Restrict provisioning to specific NFs (if omitted, use default topology).

functions.returns: Provisioning task summary including provisioning_task_id(s), initial status, and estimated completion time.

functions.name: get_udm_provisioning_status
functions.description: Get detailed status, logs, and failure diagnostics for a UDM provisioning task.

log_filter.description: Optional filtering criteria if logs are included.

functions.returns: Provisioning task status including per-NF results, error codes, and optional filtered logs.

functions.name: get_udm_subscription
functions.description: Retrieve the effective UDM subscription profile for a subscriber, optionally scoped to service or slice.
functions.returns: Current UDM subscription profile (udm_profile) plus metadata and optional change history.

functions.name: update_udm_subscription_profile
functions.description: Apply in-place updates to a UDM subscription profile, such as modifying slices, DNNs, or QoS parameters.

update_mask.description: List of JSON pointer paths indicating which fields are being updated.

patch_operations.description: JSON Patch-like operations to alter the profile.

functions.returns: Updated subscription profile snapshot along with any partial-failure information for best_effort updates.

functions.name: link_udm_subscription_to_charging
functions.description: Establish or adjust the linkage between a UDM subscription and charging/mediation systems.

charge_session_id.description: Existing charge session to reuse/extend, if any.

functions.returns: Charging linkage details including charge_session_id, applied tariffs, and any deferred changes.

functions.name: record_udm_chargeable_event
functions.description: Record a chargeable event related to UDM subscription lifecycle into the charging or mediation layer.

charge_session_id.description: Session to which this event belongs; optional.

async_mode.description: If true, enqueue event for asynchronous rating; otherwise block until rating result.

functions.returns: Acknowledgment containing event reference, rating result (if synchronous), or queue position (if async).

functions.name: cancel_or_rollback_udm_order
functions.description: Cancel an in-progress UDM order or initiate rollback of previously applied changes when possible.

rollback_steps.description: Explicit rollback steps when using manual_step_rollback.

parameters.description: Additional parameters specific to the rollback action.

retain_billing_effects.description: If false, attempt to reverse or adjust related charging events.

functions.returns: Cancellation/rollback outcome including updated order status, performed rollback actions, and any residual inconsistencies.

functions.name: retry_failed_udm_step
functions.description: Retry a specific failed step within a UDM provisioning task or order, with optional parameter overrides.

failed_step_id.description: Identifier of the failed step within the provisioning workflow.

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides for this retry attempt.

functions.returns: Result of the retry attempt including new step status, updated provisioning_task_id if forked, and diagnostics.

functions.name: search_subscribers
functions.description: Faceted search across subscriber records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for udm_subscription_order_to_cash.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of subscriber records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_subscribers_by_status
functions.description: List subscriber records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of subscriber records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_subscriber_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single subscriber record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscriber record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_subscribers
functions.description: Submit a batch of subscriber records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_subscribers

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_subscribers
functions.description: Soft-archive subscriber records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_subscribers
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of subscriber records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_subscriber_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for subscriber lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_subscriber_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created subscriber event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_subscriber_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a subscriber including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_subscriber_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for udm_subscription_order_to_cash with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_subscriber_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a udm_subscription_order_to_cash operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_subscriber_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled udm_subscription_order_to_cash job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.name: simulate_subscriber_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a udm_subscription_order_to_cash execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_subscriber_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a subscriber for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_subscriber_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending subscriber approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached subscriber to a higher tier with paging and audit.

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.
